title: 電子回路Ⅱ
subtitle: Electronic Circuits II
keywords: Boolean function 2.Logic circuits 3.Flip-flops 4.Counter circuits 5.A/D D/A converter
educationalGoal: Electronic circuits is a very important topic. In this subject, Digital Circuits, the objective is to learn the fndamentals of Boolean equations (logic algebra) and logic circuits, and to understand the principles behind how various logic circuits operate.In addition to combined logic circuits such as AND, OR, and NOT gates, the students will learn to understand and explain the operating principles of sequential circuits such as flip-flops and counters as well as more functional circuits such as analog to digital(A/D) and digital to analog (D/A) converters.
advice: We will cover the following materials. 1. Fundamental logic circuits and boolean function AND, OR, NOT, EX-OR 2. Design for combination logical circuit Conversion circuit (NAND, NOR) Simplification using the karnaugh map Logical circuit design Adder Circuit 3. Flip Flop(FF) Circuit Synchronous / asynchronous 4 types of FF RS-FF, JK-FF, T-FF, D-FF 4. Counter Circuit Synchronous/asynchronous type UP/DOWN counter Ripple counter Shift resister 5. A/D and D/A converter circuit Principle and design
requiredKnowledge: All you need to study this subject is to understand the physical electronics and basic electric circuit.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the digital electronics and fundamental logicl circuits.
Be able to design the basic combination logical circuit.
Be able to explain the 4 types for Flip Flop.
Be able to design the synchro and asynchro type digital counter circuit.
Be able to explain the principle opreration for A/D and D/A converter.

achievementLevels.ideal: ●To sufficiently explain the design of combined logic circuits (NAND, mutual conversion to NOR circuits, simplification using Karnaugh maps, Adder circuits, etc.). ● To sufficiently explain asynchronous/synchronous flip-flop circuits (Triggering FF circuits, RS-FF, JK-FF, T-FF, D-FF). In addition, the ability to apply multiple FF components to design digital circuits. ● The ability to explain synchronous counters, asynchronous counters, shift registers, and to design complex counter circuits. ● To sufficiently explain A/D and D/A converter basic construction and operation principles.
achievementLevels.standard: ● Have the ability to design basic combination logic circuits, and particularly be able to explain the simplification process using Karnaugh map. ● Be able to explain specifications for the 4 types of FFs. ● Be able to explain synchronous/asynchronous digital counters. ● Be able to explain the principle of A/D and D/A converter circuits.
